summary.text: Christopher Jones is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia House of Delegates District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Justin Beanard.
A product manager and U.S. Navy veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his platform focuses on working families and practical solutions.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Jones graduated from Parkersburg High School, served in the U.S. Navy, and his career experience includes working as a product manager.
He advanced from the Democratic primary for West Virginia House of Delegates District 10 on May 12, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Jones said he supports stronger public education, pro-union policies, and protecting access to health care, including reproductive care.
He also said he takes a balanced approach to energy policy, supporting current jobs while planning responsibly for the future.
